original_redirect_behavior: Used requests.get(allow_redirects=True) blindly following all redirects up to the requests library default (30) without any SSRF destination validation.
ssrf_vulnerability: Confirmed. A malicious public URL could redirect the backend to fetch internal resources like http://127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254.
ssrf_mitigation: Switched to a manual redirect loop (allow_redirects=False) checking every destination URL dynamically against private/loopback/link-local boundaries before issuing the GET.
ip_ranges_protected: All private subnets (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x), loopback (127.x, ::1), link-local (169.254.x), multicast, reserved, and unspecified IPs.
dns_validation_approach: Employs standard library socket.getaddrinfo to resolve hostnames before every request, explicitly inspecting the underlying routing IPs via the ipaddress module.
redirect_validation_approach: Every new Location header URL is joined and resolved before the subsequent loop iteration triggers the actual HTTP network fetch.
loop_handling: Manual history check ensures a destination URL is not requested twice within the same chain, stopping loops immediately.
cross_domain_behavior: Preserved correctly. Checks initial and final resolved public domains.
public_url_test_results: All legitimate sites (google, python.org, example.com) successfully completed without tripping protections.
direct_ssrf_test_results: Immediate safe block on 127.0.0.1, localhost, 10.0.0.1, 192.168.1.1, [::1]. Zero requests fired.
redirect_to_private_test_results: Mock public -> 127.0.0.1 correctly halted at the redirect jump. Chain correctly records the block point without fetching 127.0.0.1.
redirect_limit_test_result: Stopped exactly at 10 follows (11 initial+redirects). Total chain length bound properly.
api_integration_result: Prediction service correctly parses the hardened redirect payloads. Final ML and RiskEngine functionality perfectly preserved.
